whatIsIt.eli5: Two volume knobs: one for each layer of notes, one for each place in the picture.
whatIsIt.simple: Channel attention (which channels matter) followed by spatial attention (which places matter), using a 7×7 conv on the channel mean and max.
whatIsIt.engineer: Ultralytics CBAM: ChannelAttention(GAP → 1×1 → σ) then SpatialAttention(cat[mean, max] → Conv7×7 → σ).

whyExists.eli5: Small weeds are in a few places; this helps the model look there.
whyExists.simple: Spatial attention can highlight small regions, which is why CBAM is a common choice for small-object work. Gains are not guaranteed and must be tested.
whyExists.engineer: Sequential channel and spatial gating (Woo et al., 2018).

eli5: Make a heat map of where to look.
simple: Channel weights from a global average and a 1×1 Conv.
Spatial weights from a 7×7 Conv on the mean and max over channels.
engineer: Ultralytics' version uses a full c×c 1×1 conv (no reduction).

costNote.simple: About c² + c + 98 parameters. Already in Ultralytics; it only needs the parse_model edit so the channels are filled in automatically.
